Introduction.hero_badge: A New Era of Career Guidance
Introduction.hero_heading_text: Great success begins with choosing the right job you love.
Introduction.platforms_desc: Our platform collects job data from online recruitment platforms. The data is updated every day to provide reliable information for IT job market guidance.
Introduction.platforms_itviec_desc: ITViec is one of the leading IT recruitment platforms in Vietnam. It connects thousands of IT professionals with trusted companies.
Introduction.platforms_topdev_desc: TopDev is a leading IT recruitment platform in Vietnam. It connects developers with technology companies.
Introduction.platforms_itjobs_desc: ITJobs is a job website for IT professionals in Vietnam. It offers many career opportunities in the technology industry.
Introduction.platforms_vietnamworks_desc: VietnamWorks is one of the oldest and largest job recruitment platforms in Vietnam, offering a wide range of IT job listings.
Introduction.features_subtitle: We combine IT job market data with your personal skills to provide career advice that matches company needs.
Introduction.feature_1_desc: Collect and combine the skills required for different jobs to find current hiring trends.
Introduction.feature_2_desc: Use Hybrid RAG and AI Agentic models to collect, analyse, and provide market data for career advice.
Introduction.feature_3_desc: Analyse your personal information, goals, skills, and CV to provide a better career advice experience.
Introduction.stats_title: The IT Job Market at a Glance
Introduction.stats_desc: Explore jobs, companies, skills, and market data collected by AIJMC.

Footer.description: An IT job market guidance platform that helps users find the right career path.

AIJMCInfo.problem_1_desc: Provide an IT career guidance system based on the latest recruitment trends and job market data.
AIJMCInfo.problem_2_desc: Help IT job seekers find jobs that match their skills, interests, and career goals.
AIJMCInfo.problem_3_desc: Show that a multi-agent system can support career guidance through analysis, recommendations, and personalisation.
AIJMCInfo.goals_desc: Build an AI IT Job Market Consultant based on a multi-agent architecture. The system can collect, process, and analyse recruitment data from different sources.
AIJMCInfo.foundation_1_desc: Based on research by T. M. Nguyen and other studies on AI agents and multi-agent systems.
AIJMCInfo.foundation_2_desc: Based on career guidance studies by Q. Peng and research by Q. Wang and colleagues.
AIJMCInfo.aim_1_desc: Gather and analyse system requirements through literature review and user stories to complete the Software Requirements Specification (SRS).
AIJMCInfo.aim_2_desc: Study AI agents, multi-agent systems, large language models (LLMs), RAG, and semantic search.
AIJMCInfo.aim_3_desc: Design and develop a market analysis agent, a personalisation agent, and a recommendation agent.
AIJMCInfo.aim_4_desc: Develop job search, career chatbot, and personal skill dashboard features.
AIJMCInfo.aim_5_desc: Deploy the system to a VPS, perform system testing, and complete the graduation project report.

FounderInspiration.name: Van Trung Thanh
FounderInspiration.bio_1: I am a third-year Information Technology student, majoring in Software Engineering with AI at
FounderInspiration.bio_school: Ho Chi Minh City Open University.
FounderInspiration.bio_2: I enjoy building reliable and scalable systems with Python and JavaScript. My work is guided by four values: quality, completeness, sustainability, and innovation.
FounderInspiration.quirk_desc: I sometimes overthink deadlines and can feel burned out. However, I still manage to finish my work well. In IT, I believe my biggest strength is persistence rather than problem-solving talent.
FounderInspiration.skill_1_desc: I have experience in fine-tuning AI models and using AI agents to automate software development tasks.
FounderInspiration.skill_2_desc: Security and deployment are important parts of software development. A good repository should have a clear CI/CD workflow to manage security, code quality, and commits.
FounderInspiration.skill_3_desc: There are many ways to build a system, but it is important to understand why we choose a specific design. Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) help explain these decisions.
FounderInspiration.story_paragraph_1: This project was inspired by a common problem in today's IT job market. Many IT professionals work in jobs that do not match their skills or career goals.
FounderInspiration.story_paragraph_2: For example, a tester who enjoys software testing should not have to apply for a Frontend Designer job just to find work. A junior developer should not be lost among job posts that only ask for senior experience.
FounderInspiration.story_paragraph_3: The gap between personal skills and job opportunities inspired AIJMC. With the help of artificial intelligence, building an IT job market guidance platform is becoming a reality.

general_faqs.a: AIJMC (AI IT Job Market Consultant) is a multi-agent system designed to analyze the dynamic IT job market and provide highly personalized career roadmaps based on your unique skill set.

general_faqs.q: Who is the primary audience for this platform?
general_faqs.a: It is built for IT professionals at all levels—from fresh graduates looking for their first break to senior engineers navigating complex career transitions.
No. We are a market intelligence and consultation platform. We arm you with data, trends, and precise job matching, but you apply directly to the companies.

general_faqs.q: Is the platform free to use?
general_faqs.a: The core features, including basic skill mapping and job market trends, are entirely free. Premium deep-dive analytics may be introduced in the future.

technical_faqs.q: How does the AI evaluate my skills?
technical_faqs.a: Our recommendation agent utilizes advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) and semantic search to compare your profile context against thousands of active job descriptions in real-time.

technical_faqs.q: Where does your job data come from?
technical_faqs.a: We ethically aggregate and synthesize real-time data from Vietnam's leading IT recruitment platforms, including ITViec, TopDev, and ITJobs.

technical_faqs.q: How often is the market data updated?
technical_faqs.a: The data pipeline processes updates daily to ensure that the trends, tech stacks, and job recommendations reflect the absolute latest state of the market.
Absolutely. Your skill assessments, resumes, and career preferences are processed securely and are never sold to third-party advertisers or external agencies.

TOS.title: Terms of Service
TOS.subtitle: Legal agreement and operating principles of AIJMC
TOS.hostOrg: Host: Student Van Trung Thanh from Ho Chi Minh City Open University
TOS.intro_desc: AI IT Jobs Market Consultant is a graduation project and thesis at Ho Chi Minh City Open University. The operating principles of AIJMC follow the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, the Intellectual Property Law (Law No. 131/2025/QH15), and the rules and terms of the recruitment platforms used for data reference.
TOS.intro_text1: The AIJMC system operates completely for learning, research, and personal or group use. The system does not offer a direct job application function, does not collect service fees, does not sell data, and does not aim for any commercial purpose or profit.
TOS.intro_text2: The system is deployed in a limited or public access environment for a short time to test and evaluate the thesis. The system will be closed or restricted after the project is finished.
TOS.ip_title: 2. Intellectual Property and Data Collection Policy
TOS.ip_desc: The system collects data about jobs and companies from recruitment platforms including ITviec, VietnamWorks, TopDev, and ITJobs. AIJMC promises:
TOS.ip_text1: The collection and display of AIJMC's information is based on Point a, Clause 1, Article 25 of the Vietnam Intellectual Property Law (amended and added in 2022). This states that using published works is still valid when it is for personal research or educational purposes. For the ITviec platform, they allow the use of data based on the fair personal use principle.
TOS.ip_text2: The system only collects public data from websites, does not require user accounts, does not break security, and strictly follows the robots.txt rules of the data source so it will not affect their servers.
TOS.ip_text3: All job descriptions, images, logos, brand names, and related data are the intellectual property of the recruitment platforms (ITJobs, ITviec, TopDev, VietnamWorks) and the original employers. AIJMC does not claim ownership of any displayed data.
TOS.redirect_desc: AIJMC values content ownership and respects the technical platforms that host the original posts.
TOS.redirect_text1: The system does not have an 'Apply' button. Each job post on AIJMC must include a direct link to the original post on platforms like ITviec, VietnamWorks, TopDev, and ITJobs. This protects the rights and web traffic of the content-owning websites.
TOS.redirect_text2: AIJMC clearly understands the anti-competition rules from the platforms. AIJMC promises it is not a legal entity or an employment service business, and does not compete directly or indirectly with any party.
TOS.privacy_desc: AIJMC does not ask users for sensitive personal data like Citizen ID cards, does not store long-term applicant profiles (CVs), and does not store employer information to collect fees. Therefore, it does not illegally process or share any personal data under personal data protection rules (Decree 13/2023/ND-CP).
TOS.disclaimer_desc: AIJMC is provided on an 'As is' basis for research evaluation.
TOS.disclaimer_point1: Information accuracy: Because data is automatically taken from third-party websites, AIJMC does not guarantee the completeness, update status, or accuracy of job posts. The system is provided in an 'As is' state.
TOS.disclaimer_point2: Liability waiver: The AIJMC platform will not be legally responsible for any direct or indirect loss or damage caused by users accessing the system or trusting the job information on the platform.
TOS.disclaimer_point3: External links: AIJMC does not control the content and is not responsible for links leading outside its website.
TOS.takedown_desc: Although AIJMC operates based on fair use in scientific research, we fully respect the Terms of Service and commercial rights of data-owning companies.
TOS.takedown_point1: Takedown process: If recruitment platforms find that information on AIJMC affects their business operations, please send a written request (email) to us.
TOS.takedown_point2: Action commitment: We promise to check, respond, and delete data, block domain names, or close related data collection streams as soon as possible to resolve legal issues.

Overview.subtitle: Here is your career dashboard and CV quality evaluation index.
Overview.conclusion_p1: Your CV offers a solid baseline showing clear academic history and core developer traits. However, to maximize response rates and succeed through modern ATS screening filters, we recommend implementing these improvements:
Overview.conclusion_bullet1: Quantify your project outcomes: instead of listing just responsibilities, mention performance indicators (e.g., "decreased page render latency by 24% using next-intl").
Overview.conclusion_bullet2: Align your keyword vocabulary to match target job titles (e.g., utilizing exact keywords from your chosen segment like Python/FastAPI).
Overview.conclusion_bullet3: Keep the page layout within a tight 1-2 pages maximum size.
Overview.conclusion_bullet4: Ensure high-contrast font elements so that text parsing indexes function optimally.
Overview.advantages_bullet1: Explicit listing of technical skills under proper headings.
Overview.advantages_bullet2: Clearly formatted educational history matching chronological ordering.
Overview.advantages_bullet3: Good structural clarity overall facilitating layout readability.
Overview.advantages_bullet4: No redundant descriptive texts on core credentials.
Overview.disadvantages_page_limit: CV page limit exceeded (longer than recommended sizes).
Overview.disadvantages_structure: Some sections are mapped out of order, confusing parser models.
Overview.disadvantages_text_rec: Poor scan recognition quality detected (might be parsed incorrectly by automated tools).
Overview.disadvantages_no_role: Target job title not specified in headers.
Overview.disadvantages_no_skills: Technical skill stack tags are empty or too generic.
Overview.disadvantages_no_metrics: Missing quantified achievements (e.g. percentages or KPI metrics).

Consultant.title: Market Analysis and Career Consultant
Consultant.subtitle: Personalized insights and metrics derived from current tech listings and your career preferences.
Consultant.rec_1_desc: Container usage (Docker) has become standard for Middle/Senior tiers. Packaging your frontend and backend projects into light images will give you a significant advantage in evaluations.
Consultant.rec_2_desc: Companies are increasingly hiring developers who can build secure, asynchronous APIs to feed intelligent client UIs. Explore bridging React with FastAPI/Python routing models.
Consultant.rec_3_desc: Our analytics show that Hybrid positions in HCMC currently offer a 15% salary premium compared to fully remote listings due to team coordination optimizations.
Consultant.market_summary_desc: The IT recruitment market shows a strong demand for engineering talent in AI development, cloud deployment, and system architecture. Software developers with hybrid skillsets, specifically connecting frontend framework experience (React/Next.js) with backend containers (FastAPI/Node.js), are receiving highly competitive compensation. Ho Chi Minh City remains the largest hiring market in Vietnam.
